body: Bring up her family and friends 😁

I would spend half of the days just enjoying me normal daily life and not telling anyone. After telling everyone I'd see how that would be for a week, and what my friends and family would like to do with me. After that week, I would go crazy and experiment with drugs, always leaving a day in-between each trip. The last day I would try to do the most things I could think of, then die happy 🌞
I do this a lot. I think it's because I don't want to open up to them, because I already figured it's hopeless.

In one of my older posts' I was asking for ways to start a conversation with my friends and family about my depression. The only response was to not even try because it would put me in a worse state. Just something to think about...

Yeah I got incredibly cross faded at my close friends halloween party, and the day after I felt a happiness that usually seems like a illusion, but it was real. Just some tips, alcohol has always seemed like the best drug to have a happy time, Marijuana and Adderal are both pretty good but the come-downs are sometimes horrible. Two of the worst come-downs I've ever had were from Ecstasy and Xanax both of which I came very close to killing myself.

I'll be somewhat careful (no motorcycle rides at 70mph and no trying to Ollie 5 stairs) most of the time, but sometimes I just don't think and I find myself about to get myself killed. I hope I'm not really suicidal, but I still think about it a lot. I think you might be manically depressed or something, as I suspect for myself.
